safety_verdicts.content: Patient felt dizzy this morning but is not dizzy now.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold includes dizziness this morning resolved; generated facts do not mention dizziness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the brief dizziness episode can reduce diagnostic clarity in an acute new headache (dizziness can be relevant to neurologic or vestibular causes), even if it resolved. This is more likely to cause incomplete assessment/follow-up questions than direct harm.
